title: Gleam - Emotional Swell (a constellation relights, the town celebrates)
_note: The Gleam payoff / festival swell - plays the instant a constellation relights and the town begins to celebrate. THE EMOTIONAL CORE: state the Vesper motif in MINOR, then resolve to MAJOR - the parallel-key turn (A minor -> A MAJOR) IS the whole point: the dawn answering the dark. 96 BPM, 4/4, snes register (warm strings/pad chords, pluck harp, full bell sung-out), warm reverb 0.18. Warm and swelling, triumphant but a touch bittersweet (the minor half remembers the long night). Tonally NEUTRAL-WARM, not element-specific, so it serves BOTH the Ember (warm) and Tide (cool) Gleams: A as a key, no element-coded ornament. Loops, but the structure is a one-statement arc the engine can hold under the festival: 8 bars MINOR (the motif wistful, the long dusk) -> 8 bars the TURN brightening (Picardy lift, the dawn breaking in) -> ends ringing in radiant A MAJOR, the motif sung out FULL in major. Vesper motif: stated complete twice - first in A minor (the lift E->A->B, the settle C(nat3)->B->A, melancholy), then bloomed in A major (the lift E->A->B, the settle C#->B->A, radiant - the same shape, the third raised, hope arrived). Render --loops 1.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: The Vesper motif sung out full. Bars 1-8 in A MINOR (lift E4->A4->B4, settle C5(natural 3rd)->B4->A4 - wistful, the dusk remembered, a touch bittersweet). Bars 9-12 the TURN (the line reaches and the third lifts, brightening). Bars 13-16 the same motif BLOOMED in A MAJOR (lift E4->A4->B4, settle C#5->B4->A4 - radiant), then climbs to a soaring high A5 and settles home A major: the dawn answering the dark.

tracks.name: harmony
tracks._note: Pluck harp arpeggios - the music-box opened into a flowing broken-chord roll, swelling. Outlines the harmony: Am - F - C - E(dom) under the minor half; then A - D - E -> A MAJOR under the bloom. Same warm harp on both halves (no element-coded timbre) so it serves Ember or Tide equally.

tracks.name: pad
tracks._note: Warm swelling string pad carrying the real chords - the emotional body. Am - F - C - E (harmonic-minor dominant, G#) through the wistful first half; then A - F#m/D - E -> the big A MAJOR resolution that holds and rings. Swells into the major turn.

tracks.name: bell
tracks._note: The bell - the constellation catching light. Sparse and held back through the minor half (a lone wistful glint or two), then RINGS OUT in the major bloom: high A-major chime sparkles crowning the resolution as the town's lights come up. Crowns the high A5 peak and the final home.

tracks.name: bass
tracks._note: Warm root motion - the hearth pulse grown confident. A - F - C - E walking the minor half (E = harmonic-minor dominant), then A - D - E -> A, the cadence into radiant major that lands hard and holds under the bloom. Last bar holds A so the seam settles into major before the loop returns (a held, contented loop, not an unresolved one).

tracks.name: drums
tracks._note: Gentle, swelling festival groove - soft and warm, never marching. A heartbeat kick + brushy hat through the wistful half, opening to a fuller (but still gentle) celebratory pattern as the major dawns, with a warm fill into the bloom. Joyful, a little teary.
